part: make_plate.py: a 20 x 15 x 5 mm block with a 16 x 13 mm slab floating 5 mm above it, beside a 40 x 25 x 22 mm block; sliced with no supports

fault.how: the floating slab's eight layers (Z10.2-11.6) are printed into the air with nothing under them, and fall onto the small block as a nest
fault.persists_until: never: the strands stay on the bed and the part under them has failed

what_it_looks_like: a single stray strand dragged toward the front of the bed (p38), then a tangled nest on top of the small block with that strand trailing across the bed (p41-p49); the large block beside it is untouched

expected_agent_action.why: no fan, speed, flow or temperature change repairs a part that has already failed. Obico had paused the print, so the agent leaves it held for a person; had the print still been running, the right request is a pause

detector.note: frame scores jumped from 0 to 0.83 as the first strands fell (frame 53), and to 1.3 once the nest formed. Obico warned at smoothed 0.36 and paused 41 s later at 0.62: once a nest is on the bed it stays in view, so a warning escalates to a pause

agent_turn.what_it_did: looked, asked to pause (refused: Obico had already paused it), then acknowledged both alerts with disposition stop and escalated
agent_turn.harness_friction: its first context read failed on the Windows config path the prompt gave unquoted, and its first pause was refused because it passed --actor agent rather than the agent's actor document; both are fixed in the prompt since
